result.summary: Found 4 issues: content is cut off at the right edge of horizontal scroll sections, category filter chips are truncated, and there is inconsistent spacing/alignment in the food card sections.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial view of the image and name.
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/margin to the horizontal scroll container or add a visual indicator (fade/gradient) to signal more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off on the right side, with an additional chip partially visible beyond the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility indicator at the edge of scrollable chip list to make it clearer the list is scrollable.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outlined while on the pizza card below it appears black/filled background, showing inconsistent icon styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and style across all promotional cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotion card is abruptly cut off at the bottom of the screen with no visible restaurant name or details, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent card height and full content visibility before the scroll cutoff, or add scroll affordance so users know to scroll further.
